title: 修复 CSV 引号与多行字段
issue:
Synthetic development fixture, hand-authored for PatchForge; not an external benchmark.

Repair parse_records(text), a CSV import helper. Input is a valid comma-delimited CSV string with a header row and unique header names. Return a list of dictionaries of string values using the header names. Support standard double-quoted fields, commas and embedded newlines inside quoted fields, doubled quotes, LF and CRLF line endings, and empty cells. Skip genuinely blank rows; an empty input or header-only input returns []. Preserve field whitespace. Rows have exactly the header's number of cells. Use the standard library only. The current split-based parser corrupts quoted fields.

files.solution.py:
import csv
import io


def parse_records(text):
    lines = [line for line in text.splitlines() if line]
    if not lines:
        return []
    headers = lines[0].split(",")
    return [dict(zip(headers, line.split(","))) for line in lines[1:]]
